shape: 2-portal corner (N + E gates joined at NE) with east column + long west exploration chain
description: Two-portal stage with a NE hub (mnljes) that joins both gates plus three chains: an east column going north up (vvlytt → ooiiew → sfx3rw SE pocket), a south pocket (xlunzs → spawn_north passthrough also xlunzs goes to north_gate, plus 8ytbs3 → 65zazi → y7o95f → 0pk3fq → y09rfg west chain + a4xij1 SW deep pocket). N→E is just 2 hops via the NE hub.

portals.north: spawn_north at (14.01, -23.26) — gate on the north (low-Z) side, east column
portals.east: spawn_east at (23.07, -10.44) — gate on the east (high-X) side, north of midline

anchors.description: NE hub - joins both gates + east column + west chain (matches mnljes)
central step - bridge to west chain (matches 8ytbs3)

traversalNotes: Direct N→E: spawn_north → north_pass → ne_hub → spawn_east. 3 hops.
ne_hub is the canonical 4-way dispatcher (both gates + east column + west chain).
Three pockets: SE (se_pocket, 3 hops from ne_hub), NW (nw_pocket, 6 hops), SW (sw_deep, 4 hops from ne_hub).
SW pocket has a triangle (sw_deep ↔ c_w ↔ w_mid ↔ sw_deep) — BFS picks the shorter side.
